queue.what: San Antonio company that supplies AI vision software and robotic parcel-induction cells (InductOne) used in FedEx parcel hubs.
Emeryville, CA developer of AI-powered robotic parcel-sorting systems (AmbiSort) deployed across U.S. sort hubs for Pitney Bowes and others, with about $64–67M raised.
Wilmington, MA maker of autonomous mobile robots for picking and fulfillment, used by 3PLs, retailers and UPS and DHL Supply Chain.
Warehouse robotics supplier whose goods-to-person and sorting robots serve fulfillment centers, including UPS and Walmart.
German material-handling maker whose cross-belt and loop sorters are used in parcel and postal hubs.
U.S. systems integrator (Toyota Industries group) that designs and installs multi-vendor sortation and automation for North American parcel and e-commerce operations.
Supplier of singulation, scanning and sortation systems for express and postal parcel hubs, part of Körber since the Körber acquisition.
Warehouse automation and software group that offers robotic parcel and item handling (VarioPick) and integrates automation for fulfillment and parcel operations.
